text:
Sea's Monee (Digital Financial Services) segment grew faster in FY2025, with revenue rising about 60.1% year-over-year, from $2,367.7 million in FY2024 to $3,791.6 million in FY2025 [Sea, FY2025, p.104, 105]. By comparison, Grab's Financial Services segment revenue grew 38%, from $253 million in FY2024 to $347 million in FY2025 [Grab, FY2025, p.98, 99].

So Monee's growth rate (~60%) outpaced Grab's Financial Services growth rate (38%) by a wide margin, even though Grab's growth was itself substantial and driven by lending and digital banking expansion.

By comparison, Grab's Financial Services segment revenue grew 38%, from $253 million in FY2024 to $347 million in FY2025 [Grab, FY2025, p.98, 99].
